newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to sell 52 pct of Odessa oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to sell 52 pct of Odessa oil refinery.

text.p: KIEV, April 15 (Reuter ) - Ukraine's State Property Fund plans to sell a 52 percent stake in the Odessa oil refinery to local and foreign strategic investors, the refinery's deputy chief said on Tuesday.
Hryhoriy Podhornyak said investors' shares would be divided into stakes of 26 percent each.
"I am visiting Kiev often to prepare and fine-tune details for these tenders," he said from Odessa.
No date for the tender has yet been set.
Investors would have to modernise the refinery, built in 1937. Odessa refined 1.48 million tonnes of oil last year and 2.02 million tonnes in 1995.

The property fund said the government would keep 25.1 percent of the refinery's shares, 14.9 percent have been sold for privatisation certificates and to financial investment firms, and workers and managers would own the balance.
Ukraine's six refineries' total refining capacity is up to 60 million tonnes and privatisation has started on all of them.
